notes: CardDemo's Db2 transaction-type maintenance (COBTUPDT, run by MNTTRDB2 under DSN): each INPFILE record adds (A), updates (U) or deletes (D) a row of CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE, '*' is a comment, any other type is refused. Both sides run their SQL on one real Db2 (IBM Db2 Community Edition; tests/tools/equivalence_db2.py), the table seeded from the corpus's own DB2LTTYP.ctl before each run and compared row by row after it -- trailing blanks included: a PIC X(50) host variable is CHAR(50), so a description keeps its blanks in the VARCHAR(50) column. The input exercises a new row, a duplicate key (SQLCODE -803), an update and an update of no row (+100), a 50-character description, inner blanks, a delete and a delete of no row (+100), a comment and an invalid type (RETURN-CODE 4, the program's own message residue kept: STRING does not clear its target).
